alignment.preparation: Pinned3b6e6bc baseline feature superset and historical metadata retained unchanged. Official2026-06-30 AH104/JX100 name/code roster; same-snapshot county/province boundaries, exact shared vertices, no simplification or buffering. Exact full-source conflicts removed from both owners; only closed source-supported inland gaps neutral. Old outside counties receive distinct five-province seam copies; all old seams archived. Prior directed-coastline mask and all201 prior current county objects preserved.

wanheFarmTransferConsistency.interpretation: The complete same-snapshot OSM Wanhe Farm administrative polygon is already contained in Daguan and absent from Huaining.
